en.summary: I combine interface design with AI visual creation, translating character, lighting and camera requirements into reviewable images and films.

strengths.label: Interfaces
strengths.body: Design Biyuan AI VI/UI and compare desktop and mobile hierarchy.

strengths.label: Controlled interaction
strengths.body: Design review, recovery and version-selection workflows.

strengths.label: AI imagery and film
strengths.body: Create ink film, character sheets and lighting studies; structure prompts and review output.

en.workflow: Personal AI practice: a 30-second ink film, five character-sheet images and nine lighting images. Direction, prompt organisation and output review.

practice.zh: 独立 AI 视频研究：建立参考索引与八项解析，归纳六层控制，连接分镜、Blender 白模与渲染审阅。AI 辅助生成，人负责判断；聚焦独立流程研究与个人方法应用。
practice.en: Independent AI-video research: a reference index, six control layers and eight analyses linked to storyboard, Blender blocking and render review. Human-led judgment; the practice focuses on workflow method and application.
